Someone in my household was allergic to me, so I came to Animal Humane Society to find a new home.

If you're looking for a snuggly companion, I'm your match. I thrive on affection and close interactions. I might be a bit reserved at first while I adjust, but I'll warm up quickly in a calm, moderately active home.

I like playing with toys and enjoy other busy interactions. Playful dogs like me enjoy a good game of fetch or just quietly chewing on a stuffed animal. No matter which toy I choose, I want my new family to join me in the fun.

I need to go to a home without cats.
